competitive_arenas.product_or_service_scope: Cement and clinker sold through regional production, grinding, storage and transport assets.
competitive_arenas.customer_task: Construction, infrastructure and property customers choose reliable delivered cement supply at an acceptable quality-adjusted price.
competitive_arenas.economic_scope: China regional delivered markets; national statistics are context rather than a target-company price.
competitive_arenas.value_driver: Regional realized price and volume relative to limestone, fuel, power, environmental, grinding and logistics costs, with capital utilization and cash conversion.
competitive_arenas.failure_mode: National supply discipline may not reach the target region, or idle capacity and cost inflation may compress the recovered margin.

required_overlap_dimensions.rationale: National output and price cannot settle East China or the company's realized transmission.
Fuel, power, environmental cost and clinker-to-cement conversion determine how much industry price reaches margin.
Maintenance, all capital allocation, restricted cash, debt and growth-capital return must remain distinct.

competitive_arenas.product_or_service_scope: Clinker, cement, aggregate and concrete produced or converted in Anhui and Zhejiang and delivered through Yangtze-region logistics.
competitive_arenas.customer_task: Regional customers require dependable bulk building material supply within an economical transport radius.
competitive_arenas.economic_scope: East China and the middle/lower Yangtze, with Xinjiang and overseas projects treated as separate growth cohorts.
competitive_arenas.value_driver: Limestone and river-logistics position, local price discipline, grinding/storage utilization, product mix and cost control.
competitive_arenas.failure_mode: Regional competition, coal and environmental costs, debt or capital absorbed outside the mature arena can prevent national profit-pool recovery from becoming ordinary-common cash.

required_overlap_dimensions.rationale: East China mature assets, Xinjiang grinding, Kyrgyz construction and real estate cannot share one untested earnings or cash conclusion.
